info.title: API.SH: Priceline
info.description: The Priceline API from API.SH: public Priceline data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The places Priceline suggests for a hotel search: cities, hotels, airports, neighborhoods and landmarks, each with type, id (a hotel id works with /priceline/v1/hotel), display lines, city id, city, state, country, address, ZIP code, coordinates, search radius and trending or popular flags.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/priceline-autocomplete

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: A place, hotel name, airport or landmark.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

results.name: Gen Edward Logan Intl Airport (BOS) , MA
results.line1: Boston (BOS - Gen Edward Logan Intl Airport)

get.description:
One Priceline hotel: name, star rating, full address, position, neighborhood with its description, brand, description, guest review summary, important information, amenities (also by category), policies (check-in, check-out, children, pets, payment), badges, top reasons to book, every photo by group. With `check_in` and `check_out`: every room (description, bedding, size, occupancy, amenities, facilities, photos) with each rate (nightly price, nightly with taxes and fees, total, taxes and fees, property fees, cancellation terms and deadline, payment option, price breakdown) and the lowest rate.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/priceline-hotel

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Priceline hotel id (from a hotels answer), e.g. `33456504`, or a priceline.com/relax/at/<id> link.

parameters.name: check_in
parameters.description: Check-in date (YYYY-MM-DD) for rooms and rates.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Guest reviews of a Priceline hotel: id, date, overall rating and category scores, what the guest liked, disliked and wrote, reviewer first name, country and traveler type; plus the hotel's score summary and the review filters with counts. Filter by score band, traveler type and season; sort by recency or score. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/priceline-hotel-reviews

parameters.name: season
parameters.description: Months of the stay: spring, summer, autumn or winter.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (`next_page` from the previous answer).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Hotels Priceline lists for a city, area, address, airport or landmark and a stay: id, name, star rating, brand, address, neighborhood, position, guest rating with category scores and review count, amenities, badges, photos, Express Deal flag (hotel revealed after booking), and the lowest rate (nightly price, total with taxes and fees, taxes, cancellation terms, payment option, price breakdown). Filter by star level, nightly budget, amenities, neighborhoods, brands, property types, guest rating, review categories, refundable or pay-later rates, deal type, beds, theme or nearby attraction (the `filters` list in each answer gives every value with its count). `total` is the number of matching hotels. 30 hotels per page: pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/priceline-hotels

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: City, area, address, airport or landmark, e.g. `New York, NY`, `Paris, France`, `Miami`, or a Priceline location id such as `3000016152`.

parameters.name: check_in
parameters.description: Check-in date (YYYY-MM-DD). Without dates: a two-night stay 30 days from today.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Price currency, ISO code (default USD), e.g. `EUR`, `GBP`.

parameters.name: amenities
parameters.description: Amenity codes, comma-separated, e.g. `FBRKFST` (free breakfast), `FPRKING` (free parking), `SPOOL` (pool), `PETALLOW`, `FITSPA`, `AIRSHUTTL`.

parameters.name: neighborhoods
parameters.description: Neighborhood ids from the `filters` list, comma-separated.

parameters.name: brands
parameters.description: Brand ids from the `filters` list, comma-separated.

parameters.name: property_types
parameters.description: Property type ids, comma-separated: `1003` hotels, `1001` apartments, `1017` homestays, `1022` guesthouses, `1013` inns, `1002` hostels (more in the `filters` list).

parameters.name: theme
parameters.description: Property theme id: `1` family friendly, `4` luxury, `5` comfort, `6` business friendly, `7` spa and wellness.

parameters.name: nearby_attraction
parameters.description: Attraction id from the `filters` list (hotels close to it).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (`next_page` from the previous answer).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
